description: List the most recent r/wallstreetbets DD (Due Diligence) posts that have been AI-analyzed. Returns titles only (AI-generated headline + Reddit title), affected tickers with sentiment (bullish/bearish/mixed/neutral), score, comment count, and a postId you can pass to get_dd_post for the full analysis. Cheap to call — no analysis bodies are returned. Use get_dd_post or search_dd to drill into a specific thread.

limit.description: Number of posts per page (1-50). Default: 10

name: get_dd_list
